notes.title: Skulls for the Skull Throne 4 - New Vehicle Skins
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/df265417c17ac63ccbe3b83cceeb82f6f3f42c9c.png[/img]

As part of the festival of Warhammer gaming that is Skulls for the Skull Throne 4 we’ve put Dark Future on discount at 30% off, and we’ve added five new cosmetic skins for player vehicles;
[list]
[*] True Fan (Interceptor Light)
[*] Omega (Civilian Vehicle)
[*] Go Fasta (T-Bird Thunder)
[*] Blocked (Interceptor Light)
[*] Hexed (Interceptor Medium)
[/list]
If you plan on heading out onto the highways with these new additions, grab some screenshots with the built-in capture tool and send us your best ones via [url=https://discord.gg/K6mTVpS]our Discord[/url], or tag @AurochDigital if you share them on social media.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 28th May 2020, Mytholmroyd
notes.content:
Hello all,

This update adds new Player Vehicle Skins with which to look extra stylish while dealing death to your fellow road users. If you’ve unlocked a character that uses the corresponding vehicle then you can assign that skin regardless of whether you’ve completed their Season.

If you missed some of our previous updates, click the links below to see what’s been added since launch;

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/3557193237111858940/]Duffield[/url] (20th May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026028761300/]Mugginton[/url] (22nd May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026051157245/]Coxbench[/url] (28th May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1642039362993277683/]Meenacladdy[/url] (7th June 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1643167006252949099/]Ballyhillin[/url] (25th June 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/]Suckley[/url] (11th November 2019)

[b]Improvements[/b]

- Added five new Player Vehicle Skins: True Fan (Interceptor Light), Omega (Civilian Vehicle), Go Fasta (T-Bird Thunder), Blocked (Interceptor Light), Hexed (Interceptor Medium).

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed typo: rogue apostrophe on Tutorial.
- Fixed typo: the Guided Rockets now fire in a “salvo”.

Want to swap strategies or share road war stories? Fancy a peek at what the studio is up to next? Head on over to [url=https://discord.gg/K6mTVpS]our Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/]official website[/url].

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Our latest update is now live - plus competitions and podcasts!
notes.content:
Hi there!
 
 [h1]Our latest update is now live! [/h1] 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/] The Suckley update [/url] focuses on improving visibility for achievement progress, introduces the ability to swap between vehicle skins, and brings with it bug fixes and some other minor improvements to the overall package. Read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/] full patch notes here[/url], or the quick improvements summary below.
 
[b]Improvements[/b][list]
  [*]In-game achievements menu added. This handy update shows how close you are to reaching specific achievements. It’s accessible from the Main Menu and during combat when the game is paused.
  [*]Added the ability to swap between Normal and Pro paint scheme for character vehicles, once that character is completed.
  [*]Message box and Discord button added to Main Menu.
  [*]Moved version info about game to Options.
[/list]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/63a37284a8fed7f49c6c7366022c9ded376c1105.gif[/img]

 [h1]Photo Competition [/h1] 
Each month we run a photo competition using the in-game screenshot - you can find the  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1697221160915094957/]latest one here[/url]. This month the theme is Machine Guns - enter your photos and you could win 2 games and a Dark Future novel!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1697221160915094957/]Find out about this month's competition![/url]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/6c363d7cc522edac43a889b6d6c4db90cdf557f8.gif[/img]

 [h1]Podcast [/h1] 
Want to know more behind the scenes from Dark Future: Blood Red states?
Listen to our podcast as we take you through the ins-and-outs of making a video game with episodes on the [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/the-dark-future-in-cardboard/]Dark Future board game[/url], [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/dark-future-the-video-game/]how we made Dark Future[/url], an [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/an-interview-with-james-swallow/]interview with James Swallow[/url], and the [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/the-road-to-hell-a-history-of-car-combat/]History of Car Combat[/url]. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/7430f3a9b2eed55cf17c83df17e4f538e90dc6fa.gif[/img]

Thank you again for all your great reviews here on Steam and spreading the word about the game with your friends - as a small studio, we really appreciate your support! And as always if you have any questions do let us know here on Steam, or over on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/K6mTVpS] our Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/a7410ff6f9826a49f7af9f15e902c8772682c14a.png[/img]

notes.title: Summer Sale and new content
notes.content:
Hey there everyone,

We're celebrating the launch of the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] with an awesome 25% off [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/370870/Dark_Future_Blood_Red_States/]Dark Future: Blood Red States[/url]. So, if you have it on your wishlist and have been waiting for a discount, now is the best time to get involved!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/370870/Dark_Future_Blood_Red_States/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/17b3bc095acc8587ea1a0e6cb6854e40d2c92a32.png[/img][/url]

A new gang has hit the big empty and they aren't what they first seem.

Known more commonly as the [b]Demon Engines[/b], these vehicles are controlled by a sentient AI gone rogue.

notes.title: Dark Future Post Launch Round-Up
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Was it only last week that Dark Future: Blood Red States came out? We hope you guys have been having an awesome time with it and causing as much mayhem and chaos as you can!

To do a mini-roundup of news for you:

[h1]Podcast[/h1]

The [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/an-interview-with-james-swallow/]latest episode of our podcast has gone live[/url]. This season has focused on Dark Future from its role in the car combat genre to the game you see before you.

This weeks episode is a special one though as we speak with James Swallow, one of the original writers in the Dark Future novels. The New York Times bestselling authour tells us more about his role in the books and in the game itself.

[url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/an-interview-with-james-swallow/]Take a listen now[/url]

[h1]Updates[/h1]

We've implemented two updates already to the game. The first is called [b]Duffield[/b] and includes the following changes:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/0dbf35157179558ed36e126be641ab94e8735388.png[/img]

Full patch notes are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/3557193237111858940/]available on the Discussions page[/url]

[b]Mugginton[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/c084198471fdd667ccbe5862d54da7e4307a2472.png[/img]

Full patch notes are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026028761300/]available on the Discussions page[/url]

[h1]Developers Archive[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/1ed273a4513eec1996ed396dea25007547cefdb3.png[/img]

Eagle-eyed fans might have spotted the Developers Archive that has appeared as DLC on the Dark Future page! This is a chance for you to see the many iterations the game went through since it was announced in 2014.

If you are also a fan of the Dark Future board game it includes a free PDF of the original rules and expansion [b]White Line Fever[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1084700/Dark_Future_Blood_Red_States_Developers_Archive/]Take a look now[/url]

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/aade87a5c240e51b2e71778d87e5630841e8709c.png[/img]

Want to rock out to the sounds of Dark Future? Well, you can get the whole soundtrack, composed and produced by the excellent Matthew Walker, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1084701/Dark_Future_Blood_Red_States_Official_Soundtrack/]now on Steam![/url]

[h1]Heads up[/h1]

We have a new update coming up soon that we wanted to give you an early heads up about! More details from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026035927681/]game producer Peter on the Discussion page[/url].

Till next time!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/4c1c5244fd9ad31d3d37698fde7d979b85ad2580.gif[/img]
